# OfficeHQ

A full-stack office-management web application.

- **Front end:** Angular single-page app (standalone components, lazy routes), built into
  `src/main/resources/static`.
- **Back end:** Spring Boot with Spring MVC `@RestController` endpoints, on an in-memory H2 database
  with Flyway migrations run on boot.

## Build and run

```
bin/build              # build the SPA and package one runnable jar
PORT=3000 bin/start    # start the app (serves the SPA + REST on $PORT)
bin/stop               # stop it
```

Readiness: `GET /actuator/health`.

## Tests

End-to-end tests use Playwright (in `e2e/`) and bind to `data-testid`:

```
bin/e2e                # build, start, run the specs in e2e/specs, then stop
```

content.text:
Each line of a sent invoice now has a **Credit** button. Clicking it adds a copy of the line to the invoice's draft credit note, or starts a new draft if there isn't one, and opens that draft. Issuing a credit note is refused if it would credit more of a line than was invoiced, counting credit notes already issued. Both Playwright tests pass with `bin/e2e`, and so does the replay of earlier test data.

**Stored data**
- New migration `V35__line_credit_of_line.sql` adds a `credit_of_line` column to `invoice_line`.
- Each copied line keeps the description, quantity, unit price, discount, tax rate and exemption, and is marked with the id of the line it credits.

**Server**
- New endpoint `POST /api/invoices/{id}/lines/{lineId}/credit`. It refuses the same cases as the existing Credit note button (a draft, void, written-off invoice, or a credit note itself), using a shared check.
- When a credit note is issued, it adds up how much of each line it credits plus what issued credit notes already credited for that line. If the total is more than the line's quantity, it refuses with a message naming the line, e.g. 2 invoiced, 1 already credited.
- Lines added by hand to a credit note aren't tied to any line, so this check doesn't apply to them.
- The test seed and read-back now accept and return `lineItems[].creditOfLine`.

**Front end**
- The `line-credit` button shows on each line of a sent invoice that isn't a credit note, and opens the draft credit note.
- The client's invoice list now updates the existing draft credit note's row when a line is added to it, instead of listing it a second time.
- The opened invoice's lines also carry `creditOfLine`, though nothing on screen shows it yet.

The over-credit check only runs when the credit note is issued, not when the Credit button is clicked or the quantity is changed.
